title: Two-node native execution demonstration (Fabric claim -> publication -> replay)
objective: One deterministic synthetic epoch through Fabric claim, approved execution, immutable evidence, PostgreSQL chain update, independent replay and a durable receipt; then two workers racing for one successor with identical and with conflicting results; crash and lost-acknowledgement cases repeated; no Git remote anywhere in claim/execute/publish.
problem: The design must hold on real nodes with Fabric's real workers, not only in tests.
evidence_required: evidence directory with Fabric task/attempt ids, publication outcomes, replay digests, receipts

acceptance.condition: PUBLISHED, DUPLICATE, CONTESTED, STALE, INVALID and UNVALIDATED->VALIDATED all observed as designed

notes: field demonstration; tests live in T002.
